description: This file implements the sqlstore for scheduled posts in the Mattermost server, including CRUD operations, fetching pending posts, and managing scheduled post data.

classes.name: SqlScheduledPostStore
classes.description: Struct for managing scheduled post storage with methods for CRUD operations and queries.

methods.name: newScheduledPostStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SqlScheduledPostStore instance.

methods.name: columnsForWrite
methods.description: Returns column names for writing scheduled posts, including the 'Type' column.

methods.name: columnsForRead
methods.description: Returns column names for reading scheduled posts, including handling null 'Type' with COALESCE.

methods.name: CreateScheduledPost
methods.description: Inserts a new scheduled post into the database.

methods.name: GetScheduledPostsForUser
methods.description: Fetches scheduled posts for a specific user and team.

methods.name: GetMaxMessageSize
methods.description: Determines and caches the maximum size of the 'Message' column.

methods.name: GetPendingScheduledPosts
methods.description: Retrieves scheduled posts pending processing within specified time bounds.

methods.name: PermanentlyDeleteScheduledPosts
methods.description: Deletes scheduled posts by their IDs.

methods.name: toUpdateMap
methods.description: Prepares a map of fields for updating a scheduled post.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Fetches a scheduled post by its ID.

methods.name: UpdateOldScheduledPosts
methods.description: Marks old scheduled posts as unable to send based on timestamp.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByUser
methods.description: Deletes all scheduled posts associated with a specific user.
